basic_details.job_title: TNOGA Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Technical Assistant and Personal Assistant Posts
basic_details.short_information: Tamil Nadu Online Gaming Authority (TNOGA) has published the Technical Assistant and Personal Assistant Notification 2026 on its official website. The recruitment drive aims to fill 2 Technical Assistant and Personal Assistant positions. Candidates holding a Bachelor of Engineering/Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science/Information Technology for the Technical Assistant post or Any Degree for the Personal Assistant post are eligible to apply through email at https://www.tn.gov.in/. The application process is active up to 31 July 2026, and candidates can access the official notification and

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for TNOGA Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 31-07-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for TNOGA Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 31-07-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for TNOGA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the TNOGA Recruitment 2026 is 31st July 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in TNOGA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced by the Tamil Nadu Online Gaming Authority for the posts of Technical Assistant and Personal Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: For the Technical Assistant position, candidates must hold a Bachelor of Engineering or Bachelor of Technology degree in Computer Science or Information Technology from a recognized university. Knowledge of online gaming is a plus.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Personal Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Personal Assistant post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 25,000/-.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for TNOGA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) to apply for the TNOGA Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for TNOGA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications for the TNOGA Recruitment 2026 must be submitted via email. Ensure all required documents are attached and the subject line is clear.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions of Technical Assistant and Personal Assistant in the TNOGA Recruitment 2026 are on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q8. What is the minimum work experience required for the Personal Assistant post?
faq.answer: For the Personal Assistant role, one year of work experience is required. Preference will be given to those with degrees in Information Technology or Computer Science.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the TNOGA located?
faq.answer: The Tamil Nadu Online Gaming Authority (TNOGA) is located in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, with a pincode of 600028.

faq.question: Q10. Can freshers apply for the Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: Yes, freshers are eligible to apply for the Technical Assistant post, provided they meet the educational qualifications.
